name: auto-list-products
description: Discovery-first product listing for any web admin backend: probe and record the form, then crop, fill, verify, submit - and diff a fresh probe against the record when the platform moves.

plugins.name: auto-list-products
plugins.description: Bulk product listing skill: environment preflight, platform probe recorded as a probe dump then distilled into profile.json, square crops with blank/dot guards, existing images laid into the declared slots, resumable queue, browser form filling with per-field verification before submit, post-batch audit, and a probe diff that catches the platform moving underneath the profile.
